items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I’m crazy about Thelonious Monk. I mean there’s an innovator.

ctx.x: Yeah, I loved it. I mean I’m not knocking bebop by any means. I mean I don’t want to give that impression, because I have so many records in my collection. I just love Horace Silver. His piano playing is so pure. There’s not a note that goes to waste. It’s like Duke, you know, Duke Ellington. And Monk too, I’m crazy about Thelonious Monk. I mean there’s an innovator. I mean God almighty. You have people still trying to catch up with his stuff. It’s like Tatum. I mean there’s so much to Tatum that it’s just…
I can do it, so I’m going to write it.
